subject: Customer feedback: Need a single place to connect strategy → work
body:
Hey team,

Multiple customers told our CS team that roadmaps feel disconnected from day-to-day tickets. They see slides with goals, then get lost in Jira. They want a lightweight app that:
• Shows goals/KPIs and maps them to active/next work
• Explains "why this ticket" in plain language
• Provides a weekly narrative they can share with execs

Could we explore a product that solves this without heavy process changes?

– Shahrukh

subject: Re: Customer feedback: Need a single place to connect strategy → work
body:
Love this. Proposal: **ProDuh!** — a Product Ops command center.

What it does (v1):
1) Capture problems and evidence (emails, chats, notes)
2) Generate crisp goals/KPIs from that evidence (single-pass AI)
3) Link goals ↔ epics/stories so teams always see the "why"
4) Produce a weekly narrative for execs and customers

Open questions:
• How opinionated should it be about process?
• What’s the smallest set of integrations to be useful?

I’ll draft a PRD v0 (CONF-001) and set a workshop (MTG-002) to refine scope.

– Ubaid

subject: Re: Customer feedback → ProDuh! proposal
body:
If we keep v1 narrow, we can move fast. Suggested constraints:
• Read-only to Jira/Confluence initially; write later
• Bring-your-own taxonomy (no forced workflows)
• KPI objects are first-class citizens; every story references ≥1 KPI

Tech preview thoughts:
• Frontend: React/TypeScript
• Light backend for ingestion + summarization

– Christina

subject: Re: ProDuh! – Risk & data notes
body:
Data perspective:
• Analytics is thin at most customers; event tracking is inconsistent
• We should let users declare baselines manually and upload CSVs
• Show trend deltas, not just numbers — makes exec updates easier

KPI starter set I’ll bring to MTG-002:
• Cycle time (discovery→delivery)
• % tickets linked to a goal
• Narrative freshness (days since last summary)

– Bobby

subject: Next step: Workshop invite on ProDuh! scope
body:
Approved to explore. Keep v1 thin and customer-demoable.

Decisions for MTG-002:
• Problem statement and target user (no buzzwords)
• Minimal integrations for value (Confluence/Jira read-only)
• KPI model and the weekly narrative output

If we align, we’ll greenlight an MVP spike.

– Mary
